theorem project_existsUnique (V : Domain E) (z : E) :
    ∃! p : E, p ∈ V.carrier ∧ ‖z - p‖ = ⨅ w : V.carrier, ‖z - w‖ := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hmin⟩ := exists_norm_eq_iInf_of_complete_convex V.nonempty
    V.closed.isComplete V.convex z
  refine ⟨p, ⟨hp, hmin⟩, ?_⟩
  intro q hq
  have hpq := (norm_eq_iInf_iff_real_inner_le_zero V.convex hp).mp hmin q hq.1
  have hqp := (norm_eq_iInf_iff_real_inner_le_zero V.convex hq.1).mp hq.2 p hp
  rw [show p - q = -(q - p) by abel, inner_neg_right] at hqp
  have he : inner ℝ (z - p) (q - p) - inner ℝ (z - q) (q - p) = ‖q - p‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [← inner_sub_left, show (z - p) - (z - q) = q - p by abel,
      real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have hn : ‖q - p‖ = 0 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (q - p)]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp hn)
